filter.text: During the broadband emission test, the rear lamp ESA shall be in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load (rear position, stop and reversing functions energised).
filter.test_case: Verify in the test set-up record that all lamp functions are energised at rated supply voltage, at maximum load, throughout the scan.
filter.drop_reason: Describes the test set-up and operating mode during the test.

filter.text: For an ESA not involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, such as this rear lamp, the broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25. An OATS complying with CISPR 16-1-4 may be used as an alternative.
filter.test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions of the lamp in an ALSE per CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 (or in a CISPR 16-1-4 compliant OATS).
filter.drop_reason: Specifies the test site and method (ALSE/OATS).

filter.text: The broadband emission limits of paragraph 6.5 are quasi-peak values. If peak detectors are used for the rear lamp ESA measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the limits.
filter.test_case: Check that quasi-peak readings meet the limits, or that peak readings meet the limits raised by 20 dB.

filter.text: During the narrowband emission test the ESA (rear lamp with LED modules and drive electronics) shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load (all lamp functions energised). In case of an active electronic driver (switch-mode/PWM, microcontroller) this test applies in full; in case of a passive drive (resistors/linear only, no oscillator), it applies unless the exception of paragraph 6.10 is granted.
filter.test_case: Check the test report and setup to confirm the lamp was operated in normal mode with stop, rear position and reversing functions on at nominal supply.
filter.drop_reason: Describes the test operating mode set-up.

filter.text: The ESA narrowband emissions shall be evaluated with an average detector.
filter.test_case: Verify in the test report that the average detector was used for the limit comparison.

filter.text: When measured with a spectrum analyser, the ESA narrowband emissions over 30 to 1,000 MHz shall be evaluated with an average detector at RBW (-3 dB) 100/120 kHz and a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz.
filter.test_case: Check the analyser settings in the test report against Table 1.

filter.text: When measured with a scanning receiver, the ESA narrowband emissions over 30 to 1,000 MHz shall be evaluated with an average detector at BW (-6 dB) 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms.
filter.test_case: Check the receiver settings in the test report against Table 2.

filter.text: The general test conditions for the ESA immunity test shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
filter.test_case: Check that the test report states compliance with the ISO 11452-1 general test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, frequency steps).

filter.text: During the immunity test, the ESA shall be switched on and stimulated to be in normal operation condition (e.g. the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions energised).
filter.test_case: Verify in the test set-up record that each lamp function was powered and operating normally during exposure.

filter.text: In case the absorber chamber test is used, the test field shall be established using the substitution method according to ISO 11452-2.
filter.test_case: Check that the field calibration in the ISO 11452-2 report used the substitution method.

filter.text: In case the absorber chamber test is used, the ESA shall be exposed with vertical polarization.
filter.test_case: Confirm from the test report that the antenna polarization was vertical.

filter.text: In case TEM cell testing is used, the ESA shall be tested according to ISO 11452-3.
filter.test_case: Review the ISO 11452-3 TEM cell test report for the lamp.

filter.text: In case bulk current injection testing is used, the ESA shall be tested according to ISO 11452-4, either with the substitution method and the injection probe at 150 mm from the ESA, or with the closed-loop method and the injection probe at 900 mm from the ESA.
filter.test_case: Review the ISO 11452-4 BCI report and check the method and probe distance used.

filter.text: In case stripline testing is used, the ESA wiring harness shall be tested according to ISO 11452-5.
filter.test_case: Review the ISO 11452-5 stripline test report for the lamp harness.

filter.text: In case the reverberation chamber test is used, the ESA shall be tested according to ISO 11452-11, using a test set-up with ground plane unless otherwise specified.
filter.test_case: Review the ISO 11452-11 report and confirm that a ground plane set-up was used.

filter.text: In case the ESA is tested by bulk current injection while installed in the vehicle, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-4 using the substitution method with the injection probe positioned at 150 mm from the ESA.
filter.test_case: Review the in-vehicle BCI test report and confirm ISO 11451-4, the substitution method and a 150 mm probe distance were used.

filter.text: Each lamp function submitted for approval (rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp) shall conform to the requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5 of UN R148.
filter.test_case: Run the full R148 paragraph 4 and 5 test programme on two samples for each function and check every result is a pass.
filter.drop_reason: Pure announcement that paragraphs 4 and 5 apply

filter.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the rear position lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity, standard light distribution and geometric visibility requirements in Table 4.
filter.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples at the points of Figure A3-I and within the Table A2-1 visibility angles, compared against Table 4.

filter.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity, standard light distribution and geometric visibility requirements in Table 7.
filter.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples at the points of Figure A3-I and within the Table A2-1 visibility angles, compared against Table 7.

filter.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the reversing lamp supplied shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 10.
filter.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples across the Figure A3-V grid, compared against Table 10.

filter.text: The size of the approval marking shall be based on the dimension 'a' defined in Table 1.
filter.test_case: Measure the approval mark dimensions on the part or its tool drawing.

filter.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Annex 4 Part 1, the RI values of the red Class IA/IB retro-reflector shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
filter.test_case: Measure RI with a goniophotometer at the Table 3 angles and compare to the minimum values.

filter.text: In case the lamp protrudes beyond the panel nominal line and is mounted on a surface other than convex, if the dimension of its projection cannot be determined by simple measurement, it shall be determined as the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel while the sphere is moved over the lamp in constant contact with it.
filter.test_case: Move a 100 mm diameter sphere over the installed lamp in constant contact and record the maximum variation of the sphere-centre distance from the panel nominal line.
filter.drop_reason: Annex 3 method for determining the projection dimension (100 mm sphere procedure); this is laboratory measurement procedure, not a product requirement.

filter.text: In case the lamp is mounted on a convex surface, the dimension of its projection may be determined either directly or from a drawing of an appropriate section of the lamp in its installed condition.
filter.test_case: Measure the lamp projection on the vehicle directly, or check it on an installed-condition section drawing.
filter.drop_reason: Annex 3 permissive measurement method (direct or from a drawing) for convex surfaces; this is measurement procedure only.

filter.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamp shall be verified with the vehicle unladen, placed on a flat horizontal surface, in normal condition of use.
filter.test_case: Measure the lamp height and orientation on the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface.
filter.drop_reason: Describes the measurement conditions for verifying height and orientation (test set-up).

filter.text: Two or more lamps or separate apparent surfaces included in the same lamp body or behind a common outer lens shall not be considered an interdependent lamp system.
filter.test_case: Review the lamp's approval documentation and marking for the classification of its functions.
filter.drop_reason: Definitional clarification of what counts as an interdependent lamp system.

filter.text: The maximum mounting height of each function shall be measured from the highest point, and the minimum height from the lowest point, of its apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
filter.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each apparent surface above the ground on the vehicle.

filter.text: The lateral position of each function shall be determined from the edge of its apparent surface furthest from the median longitudinal plane (for overall width) and from the inner edges of the apparent surfaces (for distance between lamps).
filter.test_case: Measure the outer and inner apparent-surface edges relative to the vehicle centreline and the vehicle extreme width.

filter.text: The colour of the light emitted by each function of the lamp shall be as specified in the colour table of paragraph 5.15.
filter.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of each function.
filter.drop_reason: Duplicate of R-0307, which states the colours explicitly.

filter.text: The non-replaceable LED modules shall be stated as not needing to be replaceable in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
filter.test_case: Check the R148 communication form for the non-replaceable LED module statement.
filter.drop_reason: Concerns a statement in the communication sheet (paperwork).

filter.text: For the visibility check of para 5.10 (no red light visible to the front), the red light of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and red retro-reflector, as installed, shall not be directly visible to an observer's eye in front zone 1. Zone 1 is bounded in height by horizontal planes 1 m and 2.2 m above the ground. It is bounded in width by vertical planes at 15° outwards from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane, passing through the foremost point(s) of contact of the planes delimiting the vehicle's overall width.
filter.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle (or in an equivalent geometric set-up), check by inspection or CAD sight-line analysis that no red emitting or reflecting surface is directly visible from any point in zone 1.
filter.drop_reason: Duplicates R-0301 (no red visibility in Zone 1); otherwise only the Annex 4 zone figure description.

filter.text: In case the stop lamp or rear position lamp does not include electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control and is used on a 6 V system, the voltage at its terminals shall not exceed 6.75 V by more than 3 per cent.
filter.test_case: Measure the terminal voltage of the lamp on the vehicle in constant voltage operating condition.
